input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment and confirms we pay only for Services ordered under a signed Order Form, with no breach or shortfall for declining further orders — the preferred position. Section 7.1 reinforces this by barring any unstated minimum-use or similar charge, and Section 12 records that we have made no minimum-volume or exclusivity commitment. Sections 4 and 8 contain no committed volumes: Order Forms renew for twelve-month periods but we may opt out on thirty days' notice (with a reminder-backstop), and the audit shortfall language in Section 22 is a true-up of audited quantities, not a take-or-pay penalty. No redline needed.
